summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly open-market share repurchases under its existing buyback program (announced 20 May 2025). From 6–10 July 2026, it bought 176,621 ordinary shares at a VWAP of approximately €27.36 and 89,640 ADS-represented shares at a VWAP of about $32.54. All purchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. This is an open-market execution consistent with a capital-return program. No tender, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is reported. Watch for ongoing buyback cadence and potential impact on EPS.
